course.title: Welding and Materials Joining Processes
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: shows the hardness profiles of a 3.2-mm-thick 6061 aluminium welded in T6 (10+5) condition (right after welding, postweld natural aging for 7 days and postweld artificial aging at $1 5 5 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ for 18 hours).
(i) Explain the existence of hardness minimum after both aging processes and recovery of full hardness near fusion boundary due to artificial aging.
(ii) Is there any method to recover full strength in the HAZ? Explain.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2020
